working_definition: Author cell type 'antennal lobe projection neuron' of the Fly Cell Atlas (Li et al. 2022; adult flies), annotated by the authors with FBbt:00007422 'antennal lobe projection neuron'. Found in: 10x:head (23 cells).
searches_performed: 'adult antennal lobe projection neuron' (exact label / exact synonym, FBbt fbbt/releases/2026-10-01)

best_match.fbbt_definition: Interneuron whose dendrite innervates the antennal lobe and whose axon innervates some higher brain center - generally the mushroom body calyx and/or the lateral horn.

justification: The authors annotated this type with FBbt:00007422 'antennal lobe projection neuron', a current FBbt cell term. FBbt has the adult-specific variant FBbt:00067123 'adult antennal lobe projection neuron', which denotes the same cells in the adult; the data are from adult flies, so the adult term is used.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Interneuron whose dendrite innervates the antennal lobe (larval or adult) and whose axon innervates some higher brain center (generally the mushroom body calyx and/or lateral horn).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: The authors' term; FBbt has the adult-specific variant, preferred because the data are from adult flies (curation rule 4).

recommendation: Map to FBbt:00067123 'adult antennal lobe projection neuron' (adult variant of the authors' term), exact match.
